summary_rows.physical_system: Matched finite 1D chain; single-site onsite barrier
summary_rows.principal_numerical_result: Clean T is unity within 1.78e-15 over |E|<=1.5; barrier T(0)=0.64.
summary_rows.validation_metric: Existing-grid interior windows |E|<=1.5, 1.0, and 0.5 all retain unity clean-chain transmission.
summary_rows.main_limitation: Finite N=10; the energy grid and ideal coherent 1D leads exclude exact band-edge points.

summary_rows.physical_system: Finite 1D symmetric double barrier with central well
summary_rows.principal_numerical_result: At E=-0.73095, T=0.999991 and central-well LDOS fraction=0.8378; the fraction is much smaller at both saved detuned points.
summary_rows.validation_metric: Five adjacent transmission samples around the peak are saved; the LDOS/total-DOS sums agree to roundoff.
summary_rows.main_limitation: Only three resonance-centered LDOS energies are stored; a finite energy grid resolves a finite-width peak.

summary_rows.physical_system: Disordered finite 1D chains with independently seeded onsite profiles
summary_rows.primary_observable: Mean, median, typical, and mean-log transmission
summary_rows.principal_numerical_result: For N=40, E=0, W=0.5 to 2, mean T changes 0.8867 to 0.1935, while typical T changes to 0.07096 at W=2.
summary_rows.validation_metric: Mean, median, typical, and mean-log T decrease with N in 6 of 6 sampled (W,E) groups.
summary_rows.main_limitation: Finite ensembles (100 realizations per condition) and four lengths; trends and fits are not thermodynamic limits.

summary_rows.physical_system: Clean matched 2D hard-wall strip, width Ly=4
summary_rows.principal_numerical_result: Away from thresholds, T matches N_open over 671 points; max |T-N_open|=7.11e-15.
summary_rows.validation_metric: Recomputed using the saved 0.05 threshold exclusion; median |T-N_open|=8.88e-16.
summary_rows.main_limitation: Clean matched finite strip; threshold neighborhoods are excluded and the device solver is dense.

summary_rows.physical_system: Smooth gated finite 2D quantum point contact, Lx=40, Ly=6
summary_rows.primary_observable: Transmission and local spectral density versus gate strength
summary_rows.principal_numerical_result: Gate scans are nonincreasing at 5/5 saved energies; max positive T-N_open over the full grid is 6.22e-15.
summary_rows.validation_metric: Saved T stays within N_open to roundoff across all gates and energies; selected LDOS maps are raw spectral density.
summary_rows.main_limitation: Five gate-scan energies and finite geometry; conductance plateaus are approximate and LDOS is not current density.
